title_en: Image Comics' Creature Corps Combines Pokémon, The Boys, and Back to the Future for the Ultimate Subversive Adventure
summary_en: What happens when you combine Pokémon, The Boys, and Back to the Future? You get Creature Corps, a very intriguing new monster-battling adventure from Image Comics.
body_en:
As the writer behind hit series like Youth and Lost Fantasy, Curt Pires is definitely one of the major up-and-coming talents in the comic book industry these days. Pires' latest project has an especially attractive elevator pitch, as it offers a dark, subversive spin on monster-battling video games like Pokémon. Prepare yourself for Creature Corps.
IGN can exclusively debut the first preview of Creature Corps #1. Check it out in the slideshow gallery below:
Creature Corps reunites Pires with 51 artist Jok. The creative team also includes letterer Micah Myers and designer Fernando Rosales. The series is published through Image Comics. Here's the official description of the series:
"I'm excited to be reunited with my dear collaborator Jok and my friends at Image Comics on my biggest launch yet," said Pires in a statement. "Creature Corps is equal parts 16-bit gaming nostalgia, the dark deconstructionism of The Boys, and the time travel insanity of Back To The Future in equal measure. It's a chaotic menagerie of comic book magic that feels uniquely its own. Did I mention we're doing a trading card game too? This is gonna be fun."
Creature Corps #1 will be released on December 2, with a final order cutoff of November 9. You can preorder a copy at your local comic shop .
For more, check out 6 comics to read to prepare for Marvel's Wolverine and learn more about the new Marvel horror series Midnight Spider-Man .
